t: 瓦迪斯瓦夫·洛基耶克公爵出任波兰国王.
te: Duke Wladyslaw Lokietek becomes king of Poland.
dz: 瓦迪斯瓦夫·洛基耶克公爵出任波兰国王.
de: Duke Wladyslaw Lokietek becomes king of Poland.

t: 苏格兰人通过签署"阿布鲁斯宣言"来重申他们的独立性.
te: The Scots reaffirm their independence by signing the Declaration of Arbroath.
dz: 苏格兰人通过签署"阿布鲁斯宣言"来重申他们的独立性.
de: The Scots reaffirm their independence by signing the Declaration of Arbroath.

te: The so-called Black Parliament at Scone tries William II de Soules and other nobles who had plotted against Robert I of…
dz: 斯克内的所谓"黑人议会"(Black Parliament at Scone)审判了威廉二世·德·苏莱斯等曾谋划苏格兰的罗伯特一世并打算将威廉置于苏格兰王位上的贵族.
de: The so-called Black Parliament at Scone tries William II de Soules and other nobles who had plotted against Robert I of Scotland and intended to place William on the Scottish throne.

dz: 在圣乔治战役中,安德洛尼科斯·阿森手下的拜占庭人伏击并击败了阿查埃亚公国的势力,确保了阿卡迪亚的占有.
de: In the Battle of Saint George, the Byzantines under Andronikos Asen ambush and defeat the forces of the Principality of Achaea, securing possession of Arcadia.
